hero.title: Settings
hero.subtitle: Appearance, notifications, country and language, and family shortcuts.

familySection.guest: Sign in to set up your family profile, kids, and spouse connection.
familySection.hint: Add children and connect your spouse. Each parent keeps their own CareMate data.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.permissionDeniedMessage: CareMate cannot send push alerts until you allow notifications in system settings.

sync.title: Sync
sync.hint: CareMate works offline. Sync pulls the latest articles, connections, and account data when you're online.
sync.neverSynced: Not synced yet on this device
sync.syncFailed: Sync failed. Check your connection and try again.

location.title: Location
location.guestHint: Sign in to set your country and language. Guests use onboarding selections.
location.hint: Used for local health content and language preferences.

legal.title: Legal
legal.openFailed: Couldn't open the link. Check your connection and try again.

account.title: Account
account.deleteHint: Erases your personal CareMate data and signs you out permanently. Care history with providers may remain deidentified.
account.deleteConfirmMessage: Your profile, emergency card, family links, and synced health tools will be permanently erased. You will not be able to sign in again. Messages and care history with providers or insurers may remain labeled as Deleted user. Active subscriptions will be cancelled when possible.
account.deleteSuccessMessage: Your personal CareMate data has been erased. You can create a new account anytime with the same email.
